schemes.name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
schemes.description: Financial assistance of ₹6,000 per year provided in three equal installments of ₹2,000 directly into the bank accounts of land-holding farmer families across India.
schemes.purpose: To supplement financial needs of farmers for procuring agricultural inputs and domestic needs.
schemes.targetBeneficiaries: Small & Marginal Farmers with cultivable landholding up to 2 hectares.

customCriteria: Must hold cultivable agricultural land in their name
Must not be an institutional landholder or high-income taxpayer

benefits: ₹6,000 direct benefit transfer (DBT) per year
Paid in 3 equal installments of ₹2,000 every 4 months
Direct credit to Aadhaar-linked bank account
applicationSteps: Visit official PM-KISAN portal (pmkisan.gov.in) or nearest CSC center
Click on 'Farmers Corner' -> 'New Farmer Registration'
Enter Aadhaar number and state details for verification
Upload land ownership details and submit application
schemes.sourceMetadata: Verified from PM-KISAN Official Gazette & Portal (Ministry of Agriculture)

schemes.name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
schemes.hindiName: आयुष्मान भारत - प्रधानमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना
schemes.description: World's largest government-funded healthcare scheme providing secondary and tertiary hospitalization cover of ₹5 Lakh per family per year.
schemes.purpose: To protect vulnerable families from catastrophic health expenditures and ensure quality medical treatment.
schemes.targetBeneficiaries: Low-income families identified under SECC 2011 data, informal workers, and rural households.

customCriteria: Family listed in SECC 2011 database or holding RSBY card

benefits: Cashless & paperless medical coverage up to ₹5,000,000 per family per year
Covers pre and post-hospitalization expenses for 1,900+ procedures
Applicable across all empaneled public & private hospitals in India
applicationSteps: Check eligibility on mera.pmjay.gov.in using mobile number or Ration Card
Visit any empaneled hospital or nearest CSC / Ayushman Kendra
Complete e-KYC biometric verification with Ayushman Mitra
Receive digital Ayushman Golden Card
schemes.sourceMetadata: Verified from National Health Authority (NHA) PM-JAY Official Portal

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban & Gramin (PMAY)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs / Rural Development
schemes.description: Financial subsidy and assistance provided to homeless families and households living in kutcha or dilapidated houses to construct a pucca house with basic amenities.
schemes.purpose: To provide affordable pucca housing with water connection, sanitation, and electricity for all eligible families.
schemes.targetBeneficiaries: Economically Weaker Section (EWS), Low Income Group (LIG), and rural homeless households.

customCriteria: Beneficiary family must not own a pucca house anywhere in India
Female head of family preferred as co-owner

benefits: Up to ₹2.67 Lakh interest subsidy under Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme (CLSS)
Direct financial grant of ₹1.20 Lakh to ₹1.30 Lakh for rural house construction
Integrated toilets under Swachh Bharat Mission grant
documentsRequired: Proof of no pucca house ownership (Self-declaration affidavit)
Land ownership or site allotment document
applicationSteps: Visit pmaymis.gov.in or Gram Panchayat office
Select application category (Citizen Assessment -> Benefit under 3 components)
Fill personal details, income proof, and bank details
Submit and record Application Tracking ID
schemes.sourceMetadata: Verified from Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs Official Guidelines

schemes.name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST/OBC Students
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
schemes.description: Financial assistance provided to SC, ST, and OBC students pursuing post-secondary/higher education (Class 11 to Ph.D.) to meet educational fees and maintenance allowance.
schemes.purpose: To boost higher education enrolment among marginalized communities and lower dropout rates.
schemes.targetBeneficiaries: Students belonging to SC, ST, and OBC categories enrolled in recognized post-secondary courses.

customCriteria: Must have passed Class 10/Matriculation from a recognized Board
Enrolled in a recognized college/university degree or diploma

benefits: 100% compulsory non-refundable fee reimbursement (tuition fees)
Monthly maintenance allowance up to ₹1,200/month for day scholars and ₹4,000/month for hostellers
Additional allowance for disabled students
documentsRequired: Mark sheets of previous qualifying examination
applicationSteps: Register on National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in)
Fill student profile, academic credentials, and caste details
Upload verified documents and select college institution
Submit application for verification by College Nodal Officer
schemes.sourceMetadata: Verified from National Scholarship Portal (NSP) Directives

schemes.name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
schemes.hindiName: पीएम स्ट्रीट वेंडर्स आत्मनिर्भर निधि (पीएम स्वनिधि)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
schemes.description: Special micro-credit facility providing collateral-free working capital loans of ₹10,000, ₹20,000, and ₹50,000 to street vendors to restart their livelihoods.
schemes.purpose: To empower street vendors with affordable credit, interest subsidies, and digital transaction cashbacks.
schemes.targetBeneficiaries: Street vendors, hawkers, cobblers, fruit/vegetable sellers operating in urban areas.

customCriteria: Possess Certificate of Vending / Identity Card issued by Urban Local Bodies (ULBs) or Recommendation Letter

benefits: Initial micro-loan of ₹10,000 with 7% per annum interest subsidy
Enhanced 2nd loan of ₹20,000 and 3rd loan of ₹50,000 on timely repayment
Cashback up to ₹1,200/year on digital payment transactions
documentsRequired: Certificate of Vending (CoV) or ULB Recommendation Letter
applicationSteps: Visit pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in portal or approach local bank branch
Check vendor status using Aadhaar or Certificate of Vending number
Fill online loan application form and choose preferred Lending Institution
Bank verifies credentials and dispatches loan directly to bank account
schemes.sourceMetadata: Verified from PM SVANidhi Portal & Ministry of Housing

schemes.name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development & Finance
schemes.description: Government-backed small savings scheme specifically designed for girl children to build a financial corpus for their higher education and marriage.
schemes.purpose: To promote financial security for female children and incentivize parents for girl child education.
schemes.targetBeneficiaries: Girl children under 10 years of age (opened by parents/legal guardians).

customCriteria: Account can be opened from birth till the girl turns 10 years old
Maximum 2 accounts per family (or 3 in case of twins/triplets)

benefits: Attractive tax-free interest rate (currently 8.2% per annum compounding annually)
Tax exemption under Section 80C up to ₹1.5 Lakh per year
Partial withdrawal allowed up to 50% for higher education after girl attains 18 years
documentsRequired: Passport size photos of child and parent
applicationSteps: Visit any Post Office branch or authorized commercial bank (SBI, PNB, etc.)
Fill Sukanya Samriddhi account opening form
Submit documents along with initial deposit (minimum ₹250)
Receive physical SSY Passbook
schemes.sourceMetadata: Verified from India Post & Ministry of Finance Gazette Notification

schemes.name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
schemes.hindiName: इंदिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय वृद्धावस्था पेंशन योजना
schemes.description: Monthly pension allowance provided to senior citizens living below the poverty line (BPL) to support their living expenses.
schemes.purpose: To provide social security and dignity to destitute senior citizens.
schemes.targetBeneficiaries: Senior citizens aged 60 years and above belonging to BPL households.

customCriteria: Applicant must belong to a household listed under the BPL category
Must not be receiving pension from state/central government pension rules

benefits: Monthly pension of ₹500 to ₹1,000/month (varies by age group and state top-up grants)
Direct Bank Transfer directly into senior citizen's account
Free medical checkups at District Government Hospitals
applicationSteps: Apply through Social Welfare Department or local Tehsil / Block Development Office (BDO)
Submit pension application form with BPL documentation
Verification by Gram Panchayat Secretary / Municipal Officer
Sanction letter issued and pension credited monthly
schemes.sourceMetadata: Verified from National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP) Portal
